reason: ADR-002 accept condition C1 re-run (PR #83) inside the disposable, network-disconnected VM albera-clone-07-lab23d (Windows Server 2025 from the golden image, guest clock set to host time first), over PowerShell Direct, within the owner's approval to run #23 only inside a disposable VM. Both services were restricted with `sc privs <svc> SeChangeNotifyPrivilege`. All request checks still pass, so the Broker peer check does not need SeImpersonatePrivilege across accounts. Guest rollback clean; the VM was deleted afterwards. Machine-specific S-1-5-21 SIDs are redacted.
